F7_prod_sink_drains_in_under_60s.detail: The prod sink went 0 -> 2 -> 0 inside ~54 seconds. Reading LLEN after the fact would have shown 0 and silently passed a delta that DID occur. This is exactly the false-negative the S7 replacement was written to catch, and it fired on its first real outing. Attribution was only possible because the consumer ledger (5s poll, Srs08P0Ha3Cv--YPx0-Yn) retains payloads in execution data.
F7_prod_sink_drains_in_under_60s.action: Keep S7b's ledger-first ordering. Prefer the runner's atomic before/after capture (zz-canary-run already does this) over out-of-band LLEN sampling.

F8_setNodeParameter_pointer_is_relative.severity: PROCESS — MCP gotcha, cost one wasted run
F8_setNodeParameter_pointer_is_relative.detail: update_workflow setNodeParameter with path '/parameters/key' does NOT overwrite parameters.key — it creates a nested parameters.parameters.key and the node keeps using the old value, silently. The pointer is relative to the node's parameters object, so the correct path is '/key'. Worth adding to docs/LESSONS.md.
F8_setNodeParameter_pointer_is_relative.action: Add to LESSONS. Use updateNodeParameters{replace:true} when unsure.
